content:
There's a lot of reasons players craft legendary gear in Guild Wars 2, despite it having no raw stat advantage over ascended gear. Some players are just infatuated by shiny things like the skritt are, while others like having the convenience that filling their legendary armory provides. Legendaries enable:
- Stat Swapping (Or Rune/Sigil Swapping For Legendaries Runes and Sigils)
- Easy Rune/Sigil Removal For Gear
- Use On Multiple Characters Simultaneously
- Epic Fashion To Impress All Your Friends and Lord Faren

Legendary crafting can be a large undertaking and will require a lot of time and gold committed for each piece of gear you make. If you're new to legendary crafting, want to use it as a method to make gold, or want to save time/gold while crafting, this in-depth video guide to crafting legendaries cheaply should provide some useful information to help you accomplish your goals easier:
https://youtu.be/T4QRChyC8CA

**Acquiring a Gift of Battle is an essential step for legendary crafting, regardless of whether you're crafting to sell for profit or to add it to your armory.**

**However, it is only obtainable through World vs. World, and not everyone enjoys that gamemode, or PvP in general. This video shows 2 easy ways to get a Gift of Battle without having to engage in WvW in the traditional way if you don't enjoy it.**

**I have to add the disclaimer that you may find that you enjoy WvW more when playing with a fun group, and we have some great people in here that teach/run WvW. I'd recommend checking out <#771894823074398209> and giving the gamemode an honest shot first.**
